systems.notes: Docs now publish each component in three flavors: Base UI (/base/, default), Radix (/radix/) and a partial React Aria set (/aria/, currently Accordion only). Component lists for base and radix are identical except Sonner, which exists only under /radix/ (base redirects Sonner to Toast). Chat-oriented components (Attachment, Bubble, Marker, Message, Message Scroller, Questionnaire) are recent additions.

systems.notes: Primary scope is the Forms and Components sidebar sections (9 Forms pages, 24 Components pages). Checks & radios and Form control pages are split into their distinct sub-components (Checks, Radios, Switches, Toggle buttons; File input, Color input, Datalists) with anchor URLs. Entries noted as Layout/Content/Helpers section are included for coverage of presentational primitives, typography and tables. Omitted pure CSS helpers: Clearfix, Color & background, Colored links, Focus ring, Position, Text truncation, plus Breakpoints, Columns, Gutters, Z-index, Reboot and the Utilities section. The Forms 'Overview' page (form-label, form-text basics) is not a separate component.

systems.notes: mantine.dev currently documents Mantine v9 (9.6.3). The inventory is the v9 docs; items not present in the v7 (v7.mantine.dev, 7.17.8) or v8 (v8.mantine.dev, 8.3.18) docs are marked 'New in v9 docs'. Everything else exists in v8. v7-only page not in v8/v9: DatesProvider (dates/dates-provider). Includes @mantine/core, @mantine/dates, @mantine/charts, @mantine/carousel, @mantine/dropzone, @mantine/notifications, @mantine/spotlight, @mantine/tiptap; other official packages (@mantine/modals, @mantine/nprogress, @mantine/code-highlight, @mantine/lightbox, @mantine/schedule) are added and flagged as outside the requested scope. Community extensions listed on /x/extensions are excluded. Compound sub-components (Checkbox.Group, Radio.Card, Button.Group, Avatar.Group, Input.Wrapper, etc.) live on their parent's page.

systems.notes: All pages in the Themes Layout, Typography, Components and Utilities sidebar groups. 'primitivesNotInThemes' lists Radix Primitives components/utilities with no Themes counterpart (from https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs).

components.name: Accessible Icon
components.purpose: Makes an icon accessible by giving it a label.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.purpose: Modal confirmation dialog that requires a response.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.purpose: Displays content within a set ratio.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Profile picture, initials or fallback icon.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Stylized small label.

components.name: Blockquote
components.purpose: Block-level quotation.

components.name: Box
components.purpose: Fundamental layout building block.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

components.name: Callout
components.purpose: Short message that draws attention (icon + text).
components.notes: Equivalent of Alert in shadcn/Bootstrap/Mantine.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Container grouping related content and actions.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Toggle an option on and off.

components.name: Checkbox Cards
components.purpose: Set of selectable cards where multiple can be chosen.
components.notes: Mantine has Checkbox.Card; no equivalent in shadcn/Bootstrap.

components.name: Checkbox Group
components.purpose: Set of checkboxes where multiple options can be selected.

components.name: Code
components.purpose: Marks a short fragment of code.

components.name: Container
components.purpose: Constrains the maximum width of page content.

components.name: Context Menu
components.purpose: Menu of actions opened on right-click or long-press.

components.name: Data List
components.purpose: Metadata shown as key-value pairs.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal dialog window above the page.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.purpose: Menu of actions opened by a button.

components.name: Em
components.purpose: Marks text with emphasis (italic).

components.name: Flex
components.purpose: Flexbox layout component.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: CSS grid layout component.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Semantic heading element.

components.name: Hover Card
components.purpose: Preview card shown when hovering a link.

components.name: Icon Button
components.purpose: Button designed for a single icon.

components.name: Inset
components.purpose: Negative margin so content bleeds to the edges of its container (e.g. card images).

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: Keyboard input or hotkey.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Semantic link for navigating between pages.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Floating panel of rich content triggered by a button.

components.name: Portal
components.purpose: Renders a subtree in a different part of the DOM.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Progress bar for a task.

components.name: Quote
components.purpose: Short inline quotation.

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: Standalone radio button usable in any layout.

components.name: Radio Cards
components.purpose: Set of selectable cards where only one can be chosen.
components.notes: Mantine has Radio.Card; no equivalent in shadcn/Bootstrap.

components.name: Radio Group
components.purpose: Set of radio buttons where only one can be chosen.

components.name: Reset
components.purpose: Removes default browser styles from an element.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.purpose: Custom-styled scrollable area.

components.name: Section
components.purpose: Denotes a vertical section of page content with consistent spacing.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.purpose: Toggle buttons for switching between values or views.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Button-triggered list of options to pick one.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: Visual or semantic divider.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Loading placeholder in the shape of the content.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Select a value (or range) along a track.

components.name: Slot
components.purpose: Merges its props onto its immediate child.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Animated loading indicator.

components.name: Strong
components.purpose: Marks text of strong importance (bold).

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: On/off toggle switch.

components.name: Tab Nav
components.purpose: Page navigation links styled as tabs.
components.notes: Link-based tabs, distinct from Tabs (panel switching); Bootstrap covers both with Navs & tabs.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Semantic table for presenting data.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Set of content sections shown one at a time.

components.name: Text
components.purpose: Foundational text primitive.

components.name: Text Area
components.purpose: Multi-line text input.

components.name: Text Field
components.purpose: Text input with optional slots for icons and buttons.
components.notes: Slots cover what shadcn/Bootstrap call Input Group.

components.name: Theme
components.purpose: Provides theme configuration (colors, radius, scaling, appearance) to a subtree.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Floating label shown on hover/focus.

components.name: Visually Hidden
components.purpose: Hides content visually while keeping it accessible.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Accordion
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Stack of headings that each reveal a section of content.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Collapsible
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Single panel that expands and collapses.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Form
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Form wrapper with built-in field validation and messages.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Label
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Accessible label associated with a control.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Navigation Menu
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Website navigation links with dropdown panels.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: One-Time Password Field
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Group of single-character inputs for OTP codes.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Password Toggle Field
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Password input with a show/hide toggle button.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Toggle Group
primitivesNotInThemes.notes: Themes' Segmented Control covers the single-select case.

primitivesNotInThemes.name: Toolbar
primitivesNotInThemes.purpose: Container grouping buttons, toggle groups and menus with keyboard navigation.
